name: 2026-08-22 — The Sacramento Visit
inGameDate: A Saturday in February 2027 (two days after Bodie). Exact day not yet pinned — see design/DM-ONLY/facts-ledger.md timeline discipline.
scenesNotReached: Scene 4 — Drive Home + Adaptive Ending (session ran out of time; Ending A coda did not fire)
summary: See summary.md in this directory — the player-facing recap, distributed to the table after the session.
playedHighlights: Dakota's reveal (Bea, the Sacramento locker, Eleanor Marsh's three ledgers, the margin note naming Vivian Loewe) landed, but circuitously enough that the party doubted whether he was telling the whole truth. Mira publicly contradicted him — rare for her, and it registered.
Morgan played Detective Ortiz's voicemail about a paperwork echo on his father's SSN nine years ago. Dakota reclaimed the spotlight within a minute; Morgan did not open up further.
The party drove in two cars rather than one, splitting down suspicion lines — Mars and Dakota in Mars's pickup, the others in Dakota's car.
Priya's migraine flared near Vacaville, as designed.
Mars's first accidental cast (presence-domain, Cheap-tier) held Elena at the door after a fumbled first attempt. Invisible to him and to Elena.
Mira's outline-vision read the negative space of a wheelchair ramp at Vivian's front walk, and she kept it to herself.
Vivian assayed the party with light personal questions. Mars, Mira and Dakota recognized it as an evaluation; Priya and Morgan read it as friendly banter.
Vivian did not recognize 'Argonaut' — the word sent her into a warm tangent about a middle-school classics teacher, and she never returned to the question.
Vivian unlocked the blue cabinet and handed her father's notebook to Dakota, with pages he had cut out himself. Mira saw the excision but did not get to read it.
Mars slipped out during the interview and tried the house's doors. All locked.
Priya ran a covert medical exam of Vivian under cover of 'the tea is weak' (the tea was fine), establishing a surprisingly strong pulse.
Rosa Vega was named; the party immediately made the Alaia connection unprompted.
Session closed on Alaia Vega texting Morgan: 'see you in Berkeley soon.'
carriedForward: T13 — the 1946-47 group photograph was NOT delivered; Ending A did not fire.
Bea callback line from Vivian did not land (interview budget overran).
Elena's line about Vivian probably dying soon — no natural moment arose.
U7 — Mira's notebook read did not happen; Dakota kept the notebook.
U2 — Ortiz callback; Morgan did not call back during the session.
T4/U6 — Ocean Beach teenagers; no text fired.
partyStateAtEnd: No longer actively angry at Dakota, but markedly warier of his circumspect manner. They accept a shared interest with him; they do not know whether they can trust him. The notebook is with Dakota. The Berkeley trip is now double-motivated (Rosa named, plus Alaia's text).

marks.note: Played Ortiz's voicemail into a hostile room, then sat with a paperwork echo on his father's SSN that does not fit the story he has told himself for two years. He noticed the nine-years-versus-two seam himself.

Held her anger at Dakota closer than she wanted to — she acts unilaterally under pressure and did not — then was the one who said out loud that a 98-year-old was expecting a call. She wanted to have it out; she went to Sacramento instead.
Goes quiet, watches, decides — and then publicly contradicted Dakota in front of everyone, which she does not do. She had watched, she had decided, and she acted. It landed.
Got what he wanted and paid for it. The party is no longer angry but is markedly warier, they travelled in two cars to avoid him, and he is holding a notebook the rest of them wanted to read.

The door at Vivian's. His first attempt fumbled when Priya interrupted; he regrouped, leaned on the railing and named the honest thing — that he needed to see for himself. Elena let all five in. He does not know he cast anything.
